readings: Match each track to its media type, dropping tracks without a match. For each media type name, work out a rate by adding up the `Bytes` of all its tracks and dividing that total by the sum of all its tracks' `Milliseconds` (one ratio of totals, not an average of per-track ratios). Show the name, that rate, and the rate divided by the simple mean of the rates of all media types (each media type counted once). Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name,
         CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS ratio_to_mean
FROM rates;
